title: One Job per Hour
statement:
You start at time `0` and can do one job at a time. Every job takes exactly one hour. Job `i` must be finished by time `d_i` (so a job done in the hour `[t-1, t]` is on time when `t <= d_i`) and pays `p_i`. A job that is not finished by its deadline pays nothing and is skipped. Choose which jobs to do and in what order to earn as much as possible.

## Input
The first line contains `n`. Each of the next `n` lines contains `d_i` and `p_i`.

## Output
Print the largest total pay.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 8000`
- `1 <= d_i <= 10^9`
- `1 <= p_i <= 10^9`
